notes: V2 four-ADC board, MATRIX_ELECTRODES_12 profile plus the two ADC4 FSR dividers: 14 logical channels, 0-11 electrodes and 12/13 FSR_A/FSR_B. Electrode R/C to ADC/AIN mapping is still missing, so channels 0-11 are unmapped and must be reported as null + NO_DATA. The 12 electrode voltages are not 36 pressure cells. No wiring, flashing or sampling has been performed.

electrodes.notes: 12 independent pressure-cloth electrodes: R1-R6 each on its own ADS1220 single-ended AIN with a 10k resistor to GND, C1-C6 each on its own AIN with a 1k resistor to 3.3V. No GPIO drives a column. The R/C to ADC/AIN assignment is not part of the harness record yet, so map is empty and mapping_status is PENDING_REAL_WIRING: the firmware emits unmapped channels and must report them as null + NO_DATA, never as invented values.

fsr.notes: FSR_A/FSR_B stay on ADC4 AIN0/AIN1 with independent 10k dividers to GND. They are independent of the electrode block; combining them is a protocol convenience, not a statement that FSR channels equal cloth cells.
